# @arki/intl

> Locale helpers for web apps: ISO language lookups, a bidirectional slug registry for localized URLs, message dictionary loading, and a TanStack Start locale provider on use-intl.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/intl/language`: `getAll639_1`, `getAll639_2B`, `getAll639_2T`, `getAll639_3`, `getEnglishName`, `getIsoCodesFromNativeName`, `getName`, `getNativeName`, `isLanguageCode`, `isValid`; types `LanguageIsoCode`.
- `@arki/intl/dictionaries`: `loadMessagesFromMultipleDictionaries`.
- `@arki/intl/types`: Configuration for a single locale supported by an app. types `AppLocaleConfig`, `LocalizedResourceSlug`.
- `@arki/intl/react`: types `LinkComponent`.
- `@arki/intl/tanstack-start`: `AppLocaleProvider`, `LocaleProvider`, `hasLocale`, `useLocale`, `useTranslations`.
- `@arki/intl/slug-registry`: `SlugRegistry`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Start here
- [README](README.md): quick start and the table of public imports.

## By task
- Language names: `getEnglishName`, `getNativeName`, `isLanguageCode` from `@arki/intl/language`.
- Localized URLs: `SlugRegistry` from `@arki/intl/slug-registry` (`getSlug`, `getResourceId`, `getLocalizedUrl`).
- Merge messages: `loadMessagesFromMultipleDictionaries` from `@arki/intl/dictionaries`.
- Mount locale in TanStack Start: `AppLocaleProvider`, `LocaleProvider`, `useLocale` from `@arki/intl/tanstack-start`.

## Rules that bite
- Lookups return `undefined` when nothing matches. `getLocalizedUrl` returns the English URL when the target is the default locale or has no slug.
- Built-in messages exist for `en` and `de` only. Pass the rest through `messages` or `featureDictionaries`.
- No pluralization or date and number formatting. Use `use-intl` for that.
- Only `@arki/intl/tanstack-start` needs `react` (optional peer).
